title: Sponge City Data Charter
purpose: The north-star set of data a city should hold, keep current and publish openly so that sponge-city principles and interventions can be planned, evaluated and monitored in public. Each indicator states the ideal, Basel's real status today, and how a gap could be filled by inference, kept apart from real data.

real_status.open: Real data, openly downloadable or queryable, close to the north star
real_status.partial: Real open data exists but falls short of the north star (resolution, coverage, format or only as a map image)
real_status.restricted: Real data exists but is not public
real_status.missing: No real data found in any open Basel or federal source

fill_status.run: Inferred by us in a pilot on live open data; shown on the map as inferred, never as real
fill_status.proposed: A known indirect, detection or synthesis method; not run yet
fill_status.none: No credible inference route; it has to be measured or published

references.label: GB/T 51345-2018 海绵城市建设评价标准 / Assessment standard for sponge city construction effect (China, MOHURD; approval draft)
references.url: https://cctc.cn/Portals/0/2020/NewFolder/《海绵城市建设评价标准》报批稿.pdf
references.note: Seven assessment items (5.1–5.7): annual runoff volume capture, source-reduction effectiveness, road ponding and waterlogging, urban water bodies, natural ecological pattern and shorelines, groundwater depth trend, urban heat island mitigation. Clause 3.0.4: assessment rests on at least one year of continuous monitoring of typical projects, the pipe network and water bodies, plus field checks and modelling.

references.label: Water Sensitive Cities Index (CRC for Water Sensitive Cities, Australia)
references.note: 34 indicators in 7 goals, scored 1–5 in a workshop; used by more than 70 cities.

references.label: VSA guideline Abwasserbewirtschaftung bei Regenwetter (2019) and the GEP
references.note: The municipal general drainage plan (GEP) must define where infiltration is possible; infiltration map, groundwater and protection maps and the contaminated-sites register are its inputs.

references.label: WaterML-UD, FAIR metadata for urban drainage observations (Eawag)
references.note: How monitoring data from drainage systems should be described to be reusable.

references.label: Berlin Umweltatlas: sealing, water balance (ABIMO) and green roofs
references.note: A city that publishes sealing, a block-level water balance and a green-roof inventory as open maps.

references.label: Copenhagen Cloudburst Management Plan (2012)
references.note: Catchment-based plan built on a calibrated city-wide hydraulic model.

indicators.name: Land cover and sealing
indicators.north_star: Polygons of every sealed and unsealed surface (roofs, roads, sidewalks, parking, planted), ≤ 1 m, updated yearly, open vector download and API.

basel.detail: Cadastral land cover: 49,595 polygons with classes such as sidewalk, road, traffic island, tram area, building, garden, water. CC BY 4.0, updated 2026-08-20.

indicators.name: Sealed share per block or catchment
indicators.north_star: Sealed fraction per block and per drainage catchment, yearly, as the basis of a water balance (runoff, infiltration, evaporation).

basel.detail: No published sealed-share or water-balance layer. The inputs are open (land cover, statistical blocks).

fill.method: Aggregate land-cover classes per statistical block (100040); a water balance like Berlin's ABIMO could follow.
fill.confidence: high for sealed share, it is arithmetic on real polygons

indicators.name: Roof form, green roofs and load capacity
indicators.north_star: Per building: roof form and slope, existing green-roof area and type, heritage constraints, structural reserve for a green roof; open, updated with building permits.

basel.detail: Open: solar register per roof (model values) and heritage roof survey (WMS/WFS). Not found: an inventory of existing green roofs, roof load capacity.

fill.method: Green-roof detection from orthophotos (Berlin method; NDVI needs near-infrared, which SWISSIMAGE RS has but not for free). Flat roofs from swissBUILDINGS3D plus the § 72 BPG obligation give a prior. Load capacity has no remote proxy.
fill.confidence: medium for green roofs, none for load capacity

indicators.ask: Publish the green-roof inventory if one exists (Kanton Basel-Stadt).

indicators.name: On-street parking geometry
indicators.north_star: Every on-street parking bay as a polygon with type and count, updated with traffic orders; open.

basel.detail: Counts per street section and type (7,817 records) are open, but without geometry. Special parking (disabled, charging, taxi) is open as points.

fill.method: Spread the per-street counts along the road edges (land cover + street segments), or detect bays in aerial imagery (DLR method); OSM parking:* tags where mapped.

indicators.ask: Publish the geometry behind 100329 (Amt für Mobilität).

indicators.name: Infiltration capacity
indicators.north_star: An infiltration suitability map (as the GEP requires) with measured permeability where available, at parcel or street scale, open.

basel.detail: No open infiltration map or permeability data found. Related open inputs: soil depth classes, boreholes, groundwater levels, protection zones, contaminated sites.

fill.method: Combine depth to groundwater, borehole stratigraphy, soil depth and exclusions (protection zones S1/S2, contaminated sites); validate with citizen-science infiltration tests.

indicators.ask: Publish the GEP infiltration map (Amt für Umwelt und Energie).

indicators.name: Depth to groundwater
indicators.north_star: A continuous map of depth to groundwater (mean and high levels) plus live levels, yearly trend.

basel.detail: Real and open at about 80 monitoring stations (hourly levels, 10-year statistics); no continuous depth map.

fill.method: Terrain height minus the 10-year maximum level gives the shallowest depth to groundwater per station: 0.8 m to 20.8 m, median 9.8 m across 81 stations. Not interpolated between stations.
fill.confidence: high at stations, none between them

indicators.name: Groundwater protection and contaminated sites
indicators.north_star: Protection zones and contaminated-sites register as open vectors, kept current.

basel.detail: Groundwater protection zones and areas, and the register of contaminated sites, are open (data.bs.ch, WMS/WFS).

indicators.name: Soil type and depth
indicators.north_star: Soil map with texture, depth and compaction for open and sealed ground, open.

basel.detail: Soil map with depth classes is open as WMS/WFS, mainly for unsealed areas; little about the ground under streets.

fill.method: Borehole profiles (Bohrkataster) for material under sealed ground.

indicators.name: Underground utilities
indicators.north_star: At least a utility-corridor density per street segment (no exact positions), open; positions available to planners.

basel.detail: The utility cadastre exists but is not public. Open: large pipelines only, district-heating area.

fill.method: Permit trail: works permits whose text names utility, sewer, district-heating, water, gas, electricity or house-connection work (7,032 construction-site and excavation permits on the map; 7,557 utility-works records on 666 streets in the wider pilot). Shows activity, not the network.
fill.confidence: medium as a density signal; no positions

indicators.ask: Publish a corridor-density class per street segment (IWB, Tiefbauamt).

indicators.name: Sewer and drainage network (GEP)
indicators.north_star: Pipes, manholes, gullies, combined or separate system, overflows, catchments, with the GEP; open, at least as a simplified network.

basel.detail: Not found in any open Basel or federal source. Only the wastewater-plant catchment (13 polygons) is open.

fill.method: SWMManywhere or the Eawag sewer generator from streets, terrain and buildings; checked against the 96 streets with sewer-works permits.
fill.confidence: low: a plausible network, never the real one

indicators.ask: Publish gully points and a combined/separate flag per street segment (Tiefbauamt, AUE).

indicators.name: Gullies and inlets
indicators.north_star: Every street gully and inlet as a point with its connection, open.

basel.detail: No open gully data found.

fill.method: Detection in street-level photos (Mapillary manhole class, published storm-drain detectors) or true orthophotos; OSM manhole=drain.

indicators.name: Overland flow and ponding
indicators.north_star: Pluvial flood hazard from a calibrated city model, plus recorded ponding and flooding events.

basel.detail: Federal overland-flow hazard map (modelled, simplified, not field-verified) and cantonal river flood hazard maps are open. No open record of flooding events in streets.

indicators.ask: Publish recorded flooding and ponding events.

indicators.name: Rainfall at high resolution
indicators.north_star: Rain gauges and radar at ≤ 10 minutes and ≤ 1 km, long records for design storms and event analysis.

basel.detail: MeteoSwiss Basel/Binningen station (10-minute data, long records), radar precipitation (last 14 days), climate scenarios CH2025; city sensors with hourly rain (raw).

indicators.name: Flow and overflow monitoring in the network
indicators.north_star: Flows, levels and combined-sewer overflow events at key points, open in a FAIR format (e.g. WaterML-UD).

basel.detail: No open sewer flow or overflow data found.

fill.method: Has to be measured and published by the operator.

indicators.ask: Publish overflow events and flows (sewer and treatment-plant operators).

indicators.name: Rivers and receiving waters
indicators.north_star: Levels, flows and quality of rivers and streams, live and open.

basel.detail: Rhine, Birs and Wiese levels and flows every 5 minutes (BAFU, CC0), Rhine monitoring station, surface-water analyses.

indicators.name: Tree inventory
indicators.north_star: Every public tree with species, age, size and condition, updated continuously, open.

basel.detail: Tree cadastre: 32,378 trees (12,504 street trees) with species, years at site, protection status; daily updates.

indicators.name: Tree pit and root space
indicators.north_star: Per tree: pit area and volume, substrate, connected trench or not.

basel.detail: The tree cadastre has no pit size or root-space field.

fill.method: A street tree whose point lies in a sealed land-cover polygon has a pit below the survey's mapping threshold (likely a grate pit); one in a planted polygon stands in a mapped strip of known area. 9,132 sealed, 3,372 planted.
fill.confidence: medium: enlarged pits below the threshold are missed

indicators.ask: Add a pit-area field to the tree cadastre (Stadtgärtnerei).

indicators.name: Canopy cover over time
indicators.north_star: LiDAR canopy every 3 years or better, open.

basel.detail: LiDAR canopy cover for 2012, 2021 and 2024 (0.5 m, GeoTIFF).

indicators.name: Soil moisture and tree water stress
indicators.north_star: Soil-moisture sensors at representative trees and sponge measures, live and open (as in Berlin's QTrees).

basel.detail: No open soil-moisture or tree-stress sensor data found.

indicators.name: Urban climate analysis
indicators.north_star: Heat stress, heat-island and cold-air maps for today and scenarios, as open grids.

basel.detail: Climate analysis 2019 and 2030 (PET, heat island, air temperature, cold air) open as map images; the grids are in the geodata shop.

indicators.ask: Publish the climate-analysis grids as open GeoTIFFs.

indicators.name: Street-level temperature
indicators.north_star: Calibrated air and surface temperature sensors across street types, live and open.

basel.detail: About 200 city sensors with hourly air temperature, open but raw (not quality-checked).

indicators.name: Suitability and priority areas
indicators.north_star: Published suitability of streets for sponge measures and priority areas for heat and water.

basel.detail: Sponge suitability by daily traffic for 6,519 street segments, and heat focus areas from the city climate concept.

indicators.name: Ownership and public realm
indicators.north_star: Parcels and public-realm boundaries, open.

basel.detail: Parcels with EGRID and public-realm (Allmend) parcels are open.

indicators.name: Works calendar (dig windows)
indicators.north_star: Planned street and utility works per segment, years ahead, open, so sponge measures can join them.

basel.detail: Public-ground permits (150,799, daily) and construction sites are open; no multi-year coordinated works plan is published.

fill.method: Permits with an end date from today onwards are upcoming dig windows.
fill.confidence: high for the permits shown; only what is already permitted

indicators.ask: Publish the coordinated multi-year works plan.

indicators.name: Registry of built sponge measures and their performance
indicators.north_star: Every built measure (rain garden, tree trench, depaving, green roof) with location, design, date and monitored effect, open.

basel.detail: No open registry found; only 64 permit texts mention unsealing or infiltration.

fill.method: Has to be recorded by the city.

indicators.ask: Start an open registry of sponge measures (Stadtgärtnerei, Tiefbauamt).
